best_fit: Manual or pasted meeting text when I need triage (ignore vs later vs now), profile-aware draft starting points, and explicit confirm-copy before I send elsewhere—especially for time-bound asks that conflict with private availability.
poor_fit: Situations where I iterate wording after copy without rigorous re-confirm, or where room-booking threads multiply with ambiguous speakers; this trace did not test live audio, Tencent delivery, or real send/mark-sent completion.

biggest_benefit.text: Automatic prioritization that respects an explicit no-reply line, defers non-blocking material review, and escalates an urgent rehearsal confirmation with a draft that refuses 10:20 and proposes 10:40 from recorded profile facts.

biggest_risk.text: After confirm-copy, further edits can desync clipboard, UI confirmation state, and downstream summary/alerts that still anchor on the first confirmed u3 text, increasing wrong-message risk under distraction.

improvements.suggestion: On any post-copy edit, either auto-invalidate clipboard with a clear re-copy requirement or sync clipboard only after re-confirm, so pasted text cannot lag the on-screen draft.
Distinguish confirmed-sent position from draft-in-progress in summary and new alerts when confirmedText exists but the editor holds newer unconfirmed text.

For unidentified urgent booking asks, surface whether they duplicate an open u3 thread and whether my last confirmed reply already answers the dependency, without assuming approval authority I disclaimed in profile.
